## Continuum 0.5.8

- **In-app updates now install on every phone, including Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO.** After the download is checked, Continuum opens Android's own installer (the same screen as installing from the browser). If you close it, an **Install** button brings it back. Before, MIUI and HyperOS could silently block the install prompt, and the Update button then did nothing.
- **The website's Download button always gives the newest app.**

**If you're on 0.5.7 or older on a Xiaomi phone,** the in-app update may still not open. Install this version once from the website (Download APK). Updates work from inside the app after that.

Google Play Protect may ask to scan the app, because it isn't from the Play Store. Tap **Scan app**, then **Install**.
